subject.title: fix(ai): safely serialize non-Error stream failures to avoid circular crashes

question: Should OpenClaw repair and land this narrower shared-serializer branch, or select the broader provider-wide formatter proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107800?
rationale: Both branches target the same root cause but choose different formatter ownership and sibling coverage; automation cannot safely choose the permanent provider error-formatting boundary.

options.title: Repair this narrow branch
options.body: Extend this branch so the whole formatter is non-throwing and add actual Google or OpenAI Completions lifecycle proof while retaining its smaller scope.

options.title: Adopt the broader branch
options.body: Prefer the broader formatter only after that PR becomes clean, proof-positive, and demonstrably preserves all provider-specific messages.

recommendation.title: Repair this narrow branch
recommendation.body: Extend this branch so the whole formatter is non-throwing and add actual Google or OpenAI Completions lifecycle proof while retaining its smaller scope.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent provider-stream work makes this person the best available owner for selecting the shared formatting boundary.
